attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Veterinary Medicine

rules.accepted_credit_types: WV Board-approved programs: AVMA-accredited colleges, AVMA-recognized national and official state veterinary associations, AAVSB RACE, programs submitted to and approved by the WV Board; webinars count toward the classroom minimum; no credit for audio or journal reading
rules.new_licensee_rule: New graduates of the current year are exempt until the next reporting period after registration.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; hours count only in the calendar year completed.
rules.audit_note: Hardship extension requests (medical or military emergencies only) due by December 15.
rules.notes: Registered veterinary technicians: 8 Board-approved CE hours each calendar year: at least 4 h classroom scientific or webinar programs; max 4 h practice management.
rules.rule_quote: REQUIRED HOURS EACH CALENDAR YEAR: 8 WV Board approved CE hours in the field of veterinary technology.
